subject: Re: schedule change
text:
Thanks for saying what bothered you about the schedule. I understand why the late notice felt unfair. The committee had to shift priorities after the venue withdrew, and we chose the option that kept the project alive. That means some of the original help we counted on no longer fits the plan. I am sorry this landed on you without warning.

If you can still take part, I will send a shorter summary by Thursday. If not, tell me and I will adjust the rota without making it awkward between us.
